column1: # Signed GPU firmware carried by linux-firmware.
# These blobs are the vendors' own, signed by keys fused into the silicon: the
# AMD PSP and the NVIDIA GSP bootloader verify them on load and refuse anything
# else. Nothing here is produced or re-signed by rlx — bring-up hands the card
# its own firmware and the card boots itself.
# Provenance: hashes mirror tinygrad's `am`/`nv` drivers, which pin the same
# linux-firmware commit. Verify before use; a mismatch means the upstream file
# moved and the pin needs re-checking, not that the check should be relaxed.
# Format: vendor <TAB> family <TAB> path <TAB> name <TAB> sha256
# AMD — CDNA1 (MI100 / gfx908). ASIC-named rather than IP-versioned.
# No userspace bring-up covers this part; the blobs are here because an
# OCuLink-attached MI100 is the development target for `am` on Linux.
# NVIDIA — GSP boot chain (Ampere / Ada / Blackwell)
# There is ONE GSP image for every family and it lives under ga102:
# exist upstream (verified: both 404 at this commit). The image is an ELF
# seven distinct .fwsignature_* sections, so one blob covers Ampere through
# Blackwell and the chip picks its own signature.
# So the per-chip families here carry only the booter / bootloader / FMC, and
# every NVIDIA part additionally needs `ga102` for the GSP image itself. The
# asymmetry below is upstream's, not an omission — see ids::firmware_families.
